scripts.dev:apps: concurrently -k -n pc,mobile -c blue,green "npm run dev" "npm run dev --prefix mobile"
scripts.dev:okr: concurrently -k -n okr-api,okr -c yellow,cyan "npm run dev --prefix awakokr/server" "npm run dev --prefix awakokr/client"
scripts.dev:stack: concurrently -k -n pc,mobile,okr-api,okr,proxy -c blue,green,yellow,cyan,magenta "npm run dev" "npm run dev --prefix mobile" "npm run dev --prefix awakokr/server" "npm run dev --prefix awakokr/client" "node dev/stack-proxy.cjs"
scripts.dev:stack:docker: concurrently -k -n pc,mobile,okr-api,okr,proxy -c blue,green,yellow,cyan,magenta "npm run dev" "npm run dev --prefix mobile" "npm run dev --prefix awakokr/server" "npm run dev --prefix awakokr/client" "docker compose -f dev/docker-compose.stack.yml up"
scripts.build:site: npm run build && (cd mobile && npm run build) && (cd awakokr/client && npm run build) && mkdir -p dist/m dist/okr && rm -rf dist/m/* dist/okr/* && cp -a mobile/dist/. dist/m/ && cp -a awakokr/client/dist/. dist/okr/
scripts.lint: tsc --noEmit -p tsconfig.json && tsc --noEmit -p mobile/tsconfig.json && tsc -b awakokr/client && tsc --noEmit -p awakokr/server/tsconfig.json
